task.summary:
refactor(unit): remove rotational_axis and simplify angular motion model
- remove rotational_axis from Unit and Builder - represent rotation solely with angular_velocity vector - derive rotation axis from angular_velocity direction - update update() integration logic accordingly - simplify builder validation rules - update all Unit tests and examples to match new API
fixed errors from the detached head of submodules and updated tests.
Refactoring for only supported classes and tests
Added Knudsen codec and its tests.
Implemented the DSMC solver along with the required universe state and test files.
Refactor System class and renamed measure.h
Added universe field force and modified orchestrator.
